label: Acts places Paul preaching at Perge in Pamphylia

date.note: Paul's first missionary journey per the Pauline chronology Acts presupposes; Acts itself was composed c. 80–90, a generation later (hence the retrospective grade).

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, pp. 185–186

notes: Weakest of the batch: Acts has Paul pass through and speak the word at Perge, but attests no organized congregation there, unlike the Lycaonian and Pisidian cities. Harnack still lists it among pre-Trajan communities.
